$comment: Edge Functions that intentionally call no limiter. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check, and stale entries fail the audit. See scripts/ci/audit-function-coverage.mjs.

exempt.fn-banking-stream-consumer: Internal-key gated streaming consumer invoked by the banking worker; it drains a queue, so throttling would drop financial events.
exempt.fn-buurt-events-ingest: Internal-key gated batch ingest from the neighbourhood data partner.
exempt.fn-care-system-sync: Internal-key gated sync from the care system (EHR).
exempt.fn-community-events-ingest: Internal-key gated batch ingest from the community calendar partner.
exempt.fn-daily-checkin-scheduler: pg_cron scheduler. No user traffic reaches it; throttling would silently skip scheduled check-ins.
exempt.fn-daily-reminder-scheduler: pg_cron scheduler. Throttling would silently skip medication reminders.
exempt.fn-daily-status-digest: pg_cron digest job that emails the daily status summary; no user traffic reaches it and throttling would delay the digest.
exempt.fn-health-check: Internal-key gated readiness probe. Must never be throttled, or the platform will mark a healthy function down.
exempt.fn-medication-escalation: pg_cron escalation job. Throttling would delay a missed-medication escalation.
exempt.fn-medication-refill: pg_cron job that raises medication refill reminders; throttling would drop a refill request.
exempt.fn-quiet-day-detector: pg_cron job that suppresses non-urgent notifications on quiet days; no user traffic reaches it.
exempt.fn-transaction-intercept: PSD2 webhook. HMAC is verified before any handling and the ingress buffer (fn-banking-ingress-buffer) owns throttling; adding a second limiter here would reject legitimate bank retries.
exempt.fn-vital-threshold-check: pg_cron job that evaluates vital-sign thresholds and escalates; throttling would delay an escalation.
exempt.fn-weekly-digest: pg_cron job that builds the weekly family digest; no user traffic reaches it and throttling would skip a week.
